senses.definition: n.pr.loc. ( = valley—or palm—of Ēl);—station of Isr. E. of Dead Sea Nu 21:19(×2) (JE), poss. (if = valley) one of main tributaries of Arnon, e.g. W. Wâle (v. BlissPEF 1895, 204, 215).
